subtopics.name: Acidic Character and Reactions of Alkynes

questions.stem: When propyne is treated with dilute $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$ in the presence of $\mathrm{HgSO_4}$, the major product formed is:
questions.solution: Hydration of propyne ($\mathrm{CH_3-C\equiv CH}$) in the presence of $\mathrm{Hg^{2+}/H^+}$ gives an enol intermediate via Markovnikov addition: $\mathrm{CH_3-C(OH)=CH_2}$, which tautomerizes to the more stable ketone, propanone (acetone, $\mathrm{CH_3COCH_3}$).

questions.stem: When propyne is passed through red hot iron tube at $873\ \mathrm{K}$, the product formed is:
questions.solution: When propyne ($CH_3-C\equiv CH$) undergoes cyclic trimerisation by passing through a red-hot tube, three molecules polymerize to form 1,3,5-trimethylbenzene, which is commonly known as mesitylene.
